minor.name: Alone
minor.card: gains no benefit from allies — no Help, flanking or shared buffs

major.name: Severed
major.card: Blinded and Deafened to everyone but you

severe.name: Solitary
severe.card: Incapacitated, cut off from the world

supportive.name: Withdraw
supportive.description: You retreat fully from the reach of the world — gaining cover, invisibility, and eventually Total Withdrawal where damage and targeting simply cannot find you.

tiers.text: As a reaction when targeted by an attack or effect, gain half cover and become immune to opportunity attacks until the end of the turn.
tiers.card: React when targeted: half cover and immune to opportunity attacks this turn

tiers.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action you may teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space and become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.
tiers.card: 1/short rest bonus-action teleport 30 ft and turn invisible until you act

tiers.text: While no allies are within 30 feet of you, you gain advantage on all saving throws and resistance to one damage type of your choice — declared at the start of each of your turns. This ends immediately if an ally moves within 30 feet.
tiers.card: With no allies within 30 ft: advantage on all saves and resistance to a type you pick each turn

buff.advantage: all saving throws and resistance to one damage typ

tiers.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you may enter a state of Total Withdrawal — you gain resistance to all damage, cannot be targeted by spells or effects that require you to be seen or sensed, and leave no magical trace. This state ends early if you deal damage or cast an offensive spell.
tiers.card: 1/long rest Total Withdrawal 1 min — resist all damage, untargetable by anything needing to sense you

supportive.name: Quiet Mind
supportive.description: You silence the noise of emotion, expectation, and memory — sealing a creature's mind against enchantment, psychic damage, and eventually any divination short of divine will.

tiers.text: You or one creature within 30 feet gains immunity to being Charmed or Frightened until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: You or a creature within 30 ft: immune to Charmed and Frightened until end of their next turn

tiers.text: The target cannot be affected by enchantment magic for 1 minute — including Suggestion, Dominate, Command, and similar effects.
tiers.card: Immune to enchantment for 1 min — Suggestion, Dominate, Command, all of it

tiers.text: The target becomes immune to psychic damage and telepathic intrusion for 1 minute, and has advantage on all Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws for the same duration.
tiers.card: Immune to psychic damage and telepathy 1 min · advantage on Int and Wis saves

buff.advantage: all Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws for the

tiers.text: For 1 hour the target's mind becomes a sealed vault — their thoughts cannot be read or modified, they cannot be targeted by Dream, Geas, or Detect Thoughts, and they have advantage on saves against any divination or mind-affecting effect of 8th level or lower.
tiers.card: 1 hr sealed vault — thoughts unreadable and unmodifiable, untouchable by Dream, Geas or Detect Thoughts

buff.advantage: saves against any divination or mind-affecting eff

control.name: Sever Link
control.description: You cut the threads between others — stripping healing, shared features, and ally buffs until the target stands in a pocket of magic that simply cannot reach them.

tiers.text: A creature that fails cannot benefit from spells or features granted by allies (healing, buffs, Help actions) until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Fail: no healing, buffs or Help from allies until end of their next turn

tiers.text: The target also cannot communicate telepathically or magically, and loses access to shared reactions or bonded features (e.g., Pack Tactics, Link Bonds) for 1 minute. Repeat Wisdom save at end of each turn to end early.
tiers.card: Also no telepathy and no shared features like Pack Tactics, 1 min (Wis save each turn)

tiers.text: The target is isolated from all group effects — auras, zones, summoner links, and shared resistances are suppressed for 1 minute. No repeat save.
tiers.card: Cut off from all group effects — auras, zones, summoner links, shared resistances. No repeat save

tiers.text: For 1 minute the target is functionally invisible to their allies' magic — ally spells and features that require line of sight or targeting cannot reach them, and they cannot receive buffs, healing, or protective effects from any source other than themselves.
tiers.card: 1 min invisible to their allies' magic — nothing targeted can reach them at all

control.name: Null Space
control.description: You manifest a personal void — a sanctuary of silence where telepathy fails, verbal spells stutter, and magic cast across the boundary finds nothing to hold onto.

tiers.text: Choose a 10-foot radius area within 60 feet. Within it, telepathy, empathy, and magical tracking do not function until the end of your next turn.
tiers.card: 10-ft area — no telepathy, empathy or magical tracking until your next turn

tiers.text: Within the Null Space, spells with verbal components have a 50% chance of failing, and creatures are considered deafened and have disadvantage on Charisma checks for as long as they remain inside. Duration extends to 1 minute.
tiers.card: Verbal spells inside fail half the time · everyone inside counts as deafened

penalty.disadvantage: Charisma checks for as long as they remain inside

tiers.text: The area becomes disconnected from magical auras. Spells cast into or out of the space must succeed on a spellcasting ability check (DC equals your Verum DC) or fail completely. Duration extends to 10 minutes.
tiers.card: Spells cast into or out of it need a casting check {DC} or fail · lasts 10 min

tiers.text: Null Space becomes a Zone of Total Severance for 1 minute. Creatures inside are immune to divination and cannot be targeted by effects originating outside the zone. Creatures that leave the zone have their memories of what occurred inside suppressed until they finish a long rest or receive a Greater Restoration.
tiers.card: Zone of Total Severance 1 min — immune to divination, untouchable from outside

utility.name: The Quiet
utility.description: Comfortable distance, over time, becomes permanent.

tiers.text: Go unseen and unheard by anyone not actively searching for you, for 1 hour. Silence a 20-foot area. Know whether you are being watched, scried, or followed.
tiers.card: Unseen and unheard by anyone not actively searching, 1 hr · silence 20 ft · know if you're watched

tiers.text: You and up to three companions leave no trail, scent, or trace for 8 hours and cannot be found by divination. Make a room's conversation unhearable from outside.
tiers.card: You and 3 others leave no trail for 8 hrs and can't be found by divination

tiers.text: Make a place unfindable for 24 hours — those who do not already know where it is cannot locate it by any means, magical or mundane. Sever a creature's link to a scrying sensor, familiar, or bond for 1 hour.
tiers.card: Make a place unfindable 24 hrs · sever a scrying sensor, familiar or bond for 1 hr

tiers.text: Remove a place, an object, or a willing creature from the notice of the world for a month — they are not hidden, they are simply not thought of. Those who knew of them remember only the shape of an absence.
tiers.card: Remove a place, object or willing creature from the world's notice for a month — not hidden, just unthought-of

complementEffects.name: Fracture Bond
complementEffects.description: The primary effect severs the invisible threads that connect a creature to those who would protect it — dealing bonus psychic damage as ally magic finds no thread to follow.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target takes bonus psychic damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (minimum 1d6). Additionally the target's allies cannot perceive them through magical means until the end of their next turn — healing spells, buffs, and targeted effects aimed at them by allies automatically fail.
effect.card: +1 die psychic · allies can't reach them with magic until end of their next turn

upgrades.text: The bonus damage increases to two dice, and the ally perception severance extends to physical senses enhanced by magic — effects like Guidance, Bless, or Bardic Inspiration already applied to the target are suppressed for the same duration.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · already-active Guidance, Bless and Inspiration are suppressed too

upgrades.text: The bonus damage increases to three dice, and the severance lasts until the end of the target's next turn rather than yours — giving them one agonizing round where they must act completely alone before the connection snaps back.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · severance lasts through their whole next turn

complementEffects.name: Island
complementEffects.description: Distance becomes defense — isolation briefly insulating you or an ally from harm with a bonus to AC and saving throws.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, each of its targets gains a +2 bonus to AC and advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: +2 AC and advantage on their next save until your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The advantage extends to all saving throws until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Advantage on all saves until your next turn

complementEffects.name: Cut Off
complementEffects.description: For a moment they stand completely alone — unable to receive the Help action, ally auras, or any buff applied by another creature.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Verum DC or be unable to benefit from the Help action, ally auras, or any buff applied by another creature until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Wis save {DC} or no benefit from the Help action

upgrades.text: On a failed save, the target also cannot use the Help action themselves — isolation severing their ability to connect outward as well as inward.
Creatures that fail also have all currently active ally-granted buffs suppressed until the end of their next turn — existing Bless, Bardic Inspiration, and similar effects are temporarily inert.
upgrades.card: Also suppresses every ally-granted buff they're carrying
